purpose: Declared capability case collect_logs. Choose actions from current state; evaluation milestones and a preferred action order are not provided.
current_focus: Gather at least one log into the actor inventory from the world.

success_signals.description: Physical completion is decided by runtime-recorded inventory, held-item, block, container, or position evidence.

pivot_triggers.trigger: declared capability target reached with runtime evidence

focus: Find or move toward a reachable wood source so log gathering can resume from new evidence, rather than retrying the blocked collection at the current spot.
notes: Do not reopen the same blocked collect_logs attempt from the current position unless new evidence shows a reachable log.
Use movement or a fresh search only if it can expose new terrain or a different wood source.
Keep the settlement goal in mind: wood is a prerequisite for planks, tools, and a stable base.
